n06_3.finding: All unknown body and terminal-hold cell centers lie outside geometric image bounds, including across every recorded camera pose up to the map source stamp. Most lie behind the camera or inside its 0.2 m near clip. This supports a single-D435i observation-coverage explanation for the raw unknown start/hold regions; it does not by itself explain every occupancy update.

wall_r10.interpretation: N03 has prior examples where the conservative query refusal occurred while a fresh completed fusion remained available; r10 did not record pending-pair state at the request, so a transient pending-pair explanation remains plausible but unproven.

corridor_r10.interpretation: The input capture contains optimized odometry earlier in the run, then localization becomes normalized_cost_exceeded around the later probe window; therefore probe odometry timeout is consistent with a localization health lock, not evidence that no odometry was ever published.

n06_4_next_experiment.hypothesis: At fixed translation and unchanged textured surround/360-degree yaw endpoints, reducing angular rate fourfold will delay or prevent the early VINS health lock seen in r20 if angular rate is the dominant cause.
n06_4_next_experiment.single_primary_variable: yaw angular rate (profile acceleration also scaled by 1/16 to preserve the same endpoints over four times the phase duration)

profile.recorder_horizon_rationale: covers the profile 300-second wall timeout plus 8 seconds, so its end can capture the slow scan even if Gazebo real-time factor is below 1.

n06_4_next_experiment.acceptance_for_this_subtask: Determine whether localization health remains valid through the complete turn. If health locks, preserve motion and input artifacts and stop before the snapshot wait; if healthy, complete map snapshots and continue the planner-only live diagnostic.
